accessibility.description: Accessibility targets: contrast, minimum target size and the focus style.

asset.description: At most 32768 bytes inline; data URLs need developer trust.

assets.description: Brand assets: logos and the favicon.

favicon.description: At most 8192 bytes inline; data URLs need developer trust.

color.description: Color: brand seeds, exact pins, explicit role pins per mode, modes, data viz per mode and status colors.

colorValue.description: A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or a numeric oklch(L C H[ / A]).

components.description: Component tokens (the token registry, z-index left out) and defaults (variant and size), per component.

dataVizPalette.description: One mode’s chart palette: 8 categorical, 9 sequential and 9 diverging colors.

dimension.description: A space, control, icon or target size step.

fontFamily.description: A family stack (1 to 8 names, quoted by the compiler) and its font files.

fontFile.description: A self-hosted font file: a same-origin relative path (.woff2, .woff, .ttf, .otf), or at developer trust a base64 data:font URL of at most 131072 bytes.

src.description: At most 131072 bytes inline; data URLs need developer trust.

issue.description: One design-system issue: a stable code, a JSON path from $, a message and an optional hint.

issueCode.description: Every stable design-system code; aa-text, aa-focus and target-size are raised by the compiler.

layout.description: Layout widths, breakpoints and the grid (px).

motion.description: Motion personality, durations (ms) and a named easing.

roleMap.description: Explicit role pins for one mode: checked by the compiler, never moved (ADR-022).

roleName.description: A semantic color role of the token contract.

shape.description: Shape: radius (px), radius scale and border width (px).

space.description: Space: the base unit (px) and the density multiplier.

typeRole.description: A type role: family, size (px), weight, line height and tracking (em).

typography.description: Typography: family stacks with font files, the scale and the type roles.

variant.description: A named variant (high-contrast, compact, seasonal): a closed partial document of sections, orthogonal to mode.

voice.description: Voice data: tone words, a lexicon (at most 200 entries) and guidelines.

lexicon.description: At most 200 entries; keys match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$ and are never __proto__, constructor or prototype.

description: A Texuli design system (ADR-021, formatVersion 1): one closed JSON document a company or an agent writes once and every Texuli surface follows. Data only: colors are hex or numeric oklch, lengths are numbers in px, fonts and assets are same-origin relative paths or capped data URLs, and nothing reaches CSS that the token contract’s css-safe checks would refuse. Generated from @texuli/spec/design-system’s vocabulary by scripts/design-system-schema.ts; validateDesignSystem enforces the rules the dialect cannot express.

extends.description: texuli:<theme> or an exact id@x.y.z; never a range, a URL or a path. Cycles and chains deeper than 4 are refused.

variants.description: At most 16 entries; keys match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$ and are never __proto__, constructor or prototype.

title: DesignSystem
